title: Bogodogo students’ march for Flavien Nébié justice and education demands
location: Lycée Bogodogo to Ministry of Education
organizer: AESO (student organization) is reported as coordinating the march
participants_original: Justice for Flavien Nébié, killed during suppression of a school protest in 2000; students also raised fees, privatization, study conditions and exclusion.
threshold_50_evidence: AIB reports about 300 students from Lycée Bogodogo marching toward the Ministry of Education. Approximate count exceeds 50.

end_date.summary: One-day march described; exact end time not reported.

location.summary: Students from Lycée Bogodogo marched in Ouagadougou toward the Education Ministry.

scope.summary: One student march reported; no other site should be aggregated.

state_response.summary: This report does not specify a state response during/after this march.

notes: A dated public march, local site count estimate and explicit domestic education/justice demands are reported. Do not import detentions/arrests from other student actions without same-event evidence.
open_questions: Reviewer to verify AESO organizer naming/expanded identity and map demand codes to original codebook; seek same-event state-response evidence if needed.

title: ENSP anesthesiology students’ protest assembly for resumed classes and placements
organizer: Anesthesiology students at ENSP; association reportedly wrote to leadership, formal organizer unclear
participants_original: LobsPaalga reports 49 anesthesiology students and support from more than 200 colleagues at/for the protest assembly; simultaneous onsite presence of supporters is unclear.
threshold_50_evidence: Potentially above 50 if the colleagues were present; not established as simultaneous participants. No invented numeric bounds.

start_date.summary: Report dates assembly to 2 December; gathered around 08:00.

end_date.summary: Single morning assembly described; exact end not given.

location.summary: Ouagadougou, associated with ENSP students; precise assembly room/site not stated.

scope.summary: One assembly; 49 students and 200-plus colleagues described, but co-presence ambiguous.

organizer.summary: Student representatives and an anesthesiology association are mentioned; formal event organizer not certain.

demands.summary: Restart courses and restore access to clinical placements.

participants_original.summary: 49 students; report says they received support from more than 200 colleagues.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Cannot treat 49 plus supporters as a confirmed onsite count without clarification.

state_response.summary: ENSP director later met with students and said he was seeking explanations from hospitals; no final resolution established.

notes: Reported protest assembly with a domestic education demand. It is a plausible qualifying episode, but no source statement clearly says the 200-plus supporting colleagues were simultaneously present at the assembly.
open_questions: Clarify whether supporters were onsite at once and whether the gathering was public; establish actual per-site attendance; assess whether later discussion constitutes any accommodation.

title: Tanghin-Dassouri residents’ road and police-station protest over fatal police incident
organizer: Local residents; mediator/authorities present, no organizer identified
threshold_50_evidence: Threshold unresolved; no evidence of 50 people at a single site.

start_date.summary: Sidwaya reports a hot day/action following death; related event is dated 9 December.

location.summary: Residents barricaded RN1 and occupied a police station in Tanghin-Dassouri.

scope.summary: One local community action; no count across sites.

demands.summary: Justice/accountability in response to fatal police incident.

state_response.summary: Authorities were present and mediation occurred; the report does not establish a concession or a protester-targeted coercive response.

notes: Demand targets a domestic police/state accountability issue; no count is reported. Do not code police killing of the triggering victim as a killing of protesters or as a response to this protest.
open_questions: Find a per-site count; clarify action duration, organizer, resolution, arrests or dispersal. Separate triggering death from state response to the gathering.

title: Unresolved early-December school strike and inter-school protest disruptions
scope: local multi-school reporting; episode boundaries and coordination unclear
organizer: Student groups/organizers not identified by opened report
participants_original: No per-school/site count; groups of pupils are described moving between schools.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established at any single site; do not add dispersed pupils or multiple schools to infer 50.

start_date.summary: Studio Yafa describes disruption from the start of December; exact onset/day unclear.

location.summary: Multiple Ouagadougou schools; exact sites not fully specified.

scope.summary: May be recurring school-level acts or one campaign; may overlap 7 Dec march, not established.

organizer.summary: Groups of students described; organizer not established.

demands.summary: Interviewed student mentions release of detainees; originating demands and relation to 7 Dec action remain unclear.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No per-site count; cannot aggregate across schools.

state_response.summary: Article refers to student arrests, but specific arrests/dates/sites are not resolved to a unique episode.

notes: A separate distinct episode is not established; retain as a lead only. Do not count alongside 7 Dec march unless distinct dates/sites and continuity are demonstrated.
open_questions: Determine actual dates and sites, unique episode versus continuation of Dec7, per-site headcount, original demands and which arrests relate to each gathering.
